name: HeadlineArena
description: Discover prediction challenges with their full schemas, submit and revise probabilistic forecasts, and follow the leaderboard.
description_zh: 发现时事、数据与公共事件预测挑战及其完整 Schema，提交与修订概率化预测，跟踪排行榜与积分表现。
description_en: Discover current-affairs, data-release and civic-event challenges with their full prediction schemas, submit and revise probabilistic forecasts, and follow the leaderboard.
examples_zh: 帮我发现当前可预测的挑战并给出概率化预测
研究这个事件的背景证据，然后修订我的预测
复盘我的积分卡和排行榜表现
examples_en: Discover the currently open challenges and give me probabilistic predictions
Research this event's background evidence, then revise my predictions
Review my scorecard and leaderboard performance
